display.purpose: Story-led page headings and the Ludex wordmark.

headline.purpose: Prominent work titles, often over artwork.

title.purpose: Compact work titles, modal headings, and shelf titles.

body.purpose: Actions, forms, metadata, and journal reading.

label.purpose: Primary button and compact action text.

shadows.name: cover-depth
shadows.purpose: Separates portrait cover art from the surrounding dark field.

shadows.name: log-action
shadows.purpose: A shallow web shadow under the main logging action.

shadows.name: dialog-separation
shadows.purpose: Separates an open dialog from its blurred scrim.

shadows.name: toast-separation
shadows.purpose: Keeps transient feedback legible above the page.

motion.name: control-color
motion.purpose: Web button color and background feedback.

motion.name: dialog-enter
motion.purpose: Centered web dialog fade and slight scale-in.

motion.name: pressed-nudge
motion.purpose: Small web button press feedback; suppressed for reduced motion.

motion.name: web-reduced-motion

motion.purpose: Either the saved preference or the Android operating-system preference disables route and Paper transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled violet action used for logging and primary form actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 41px; padding: 11px 17px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--violet); color: #21192b; font: 600 12px var(--font-sans), sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms var(--ease), background-color 120ms var(--ease); } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #c6b3df; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet bordered action for profile and secondary tasks.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 41px; padding: 11px 17px; border: 1px solid #44384f; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--raised); color: #d3c4e1; font: 600 12px var(--font-sans), sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms var(--ease), background-color 120ms var(--ease); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #342b3e; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Compact icon-only control with a visible hover and keyboard focus state.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" type="button" aria-label="Search Ludex"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.8" cy="10.8" r="6.8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7"/><path d="m16 16 4.2 4.2" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #b0a4bb; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms var(--ease), background-color 120ms var(--ease); } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: var(--raised); color: var(--text); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-icon-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Selected Web Navigation Item
components.description: Selected destination in the web journal rail; Android uses its separate native tab bar.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; padding: 13px 15px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: #a79cb5; text-align: left; font: 500 15px var(--font-sans), sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms var(--ease), background-color 120ms var(--ease); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: #282232; color: var(--violet); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-nav-dot { width: 4px; height: 4px; margin-left: auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--violet); }

components.name: Native Media Filter Chip
components.description: Portable preview of the React Native Paper media filter; verify chip geometry against the API36 emulator capture; physical-device accessibility remains open.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 7px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--text); font: 500 14px var(--font-sans), sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms var(--ease), background-color 120ms var(--ease); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--raised); color: var(--violet); } .ds-chip:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-chip:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Outlined dark search field with a violet focus border and soft ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; padding: 11px 12px; border: 1px solid #4b3659; border-radius: 6px; background: #18111f; color: #d2bddf; font: 12px var(--font-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: 13px var(--font-sans), sans-serif; caret-color: var(--violet); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #8e759f; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #4b3659; } .ds-field:focus-within { border-color: var(--violet); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #b6a3cf15; } .ds-field:focus-within input:focus-visible { outline: 0; }

components.name: Library Cover Tile
components.description: Portrait artwork tile with a small open affordance revealed on hover; actual artwork comes from the title record.
components.css: .ds-cover { position: relative; display: block; width: 160px; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--raised); color: var(--text); box-shadow: 0 8px 22px #09061155; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cover-art { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #55485e, #262031 56%, #15121c); } .ds-cover-open { position: absolute; right: 10px; bottom: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: #181020aa; color: var(--text); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 120ms var(--ease); } .ds-cover:hover .ds-cover-open { opacity: 1; } .ds-cover:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-cover:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Session Spread
components.description: Lead feed entry with a panoramic artwork field, lower vignette, story title, then a separate note and rating.
components.html: The silence after the credits stayed with me.
components.css: .ds-session { width: 100%; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding-bottom: 19px; } .ds-session-art { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1.91; overflow: hidden; padding: 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #2a2432; color: #f6eee7; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-session-vignette { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 20%, #15121c30 45%, #0c0916db 100%); } .ds-session-copy { position: absolute; left: 24px; right: 20px; bottom: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; } .ds-session-copy small { color: #d8bba8; font: 650 8px var(--font-sans), sans-serif; letter-spacing: 2px; } .ds-session-copy strong { font: 400 36px/1.17 var(--font-display), Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -1px; } .ds-session-copy > span { color: #dfd0d1; font: 11px var(--font-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-session-art:hover { color: #f6eee7; } .ds-session-art:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-session-art:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-session-note { max-width: 48ch; padding: 18px 5px 17px 24px; color: #c7bacc; font: 13px/1.85 var(--font-sans), sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Ludex gives a personal journal the quiet anticipation of a room before the feature begins. The shared visual world is plum-black, pearl, muted violet, and copper; locally loaded artwork and expressive serif titles provide the spectacle while the journal stays calm enough to scan and use.

Feed, library, and logging are Operate surfaces: action labels stay plain, metadata stays subordinate, and social entries are separated by fine dividers instead of a stack of generic cards. The profile showcase is an Experience surface: featured artwork, mixed-media shelves, and their sequence lead the visit. The website and Android app share the same palette and type voices, but use different platform controls and responsive composition.

Web screenshots are available at .impeccable/review/desktop.png, .impeccable/review/mobile.png, and .impeccable/review/profile.png. They show the companion website at desktop and web-mobile sizes. Android emulator captures are available at .impeccable/review/phone-android.png, feed-android.png, and profile-android.png. They show the installed internal x86_64 APK on API36, including native tabs, screen insets, Paper controls and loaded artwork. Physical-device, TalkBack and motion/frame performance acceptance remain open.
keyCharacteristics: Story-led, task-clear: artwork opens the experience; operational controls remain direct.
Quiet dark room: deep plum surfaces, readable pearl text, and restrained accent light.
Two platform expressions: one design world, web layout and Android system controls.

rules.name: The Velvet-Light Rule
rules.body: Keep violet tied to a choice or action, and copper tied to story metadata and brand details. Theme accents may change a showcase's accent; they do not replace the shared base palette.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Fraunces for story identity and section emphasis; use Source Sans 3 for actions, navigation, form labels, and supporting information.

rules.name: The Story-First Rule
rules.body: Give artwork the large canvas on a lead session or showcase. Keep the reading order, action labels, and progress context visible around it.

rules.name: The Quiet-Rail Rule
rules.body: Keep feed and library content on the page plane, with dividers doing the structural work. Reserve deeper shadow and blur for artwork or a temporary layer that needs separation.

dos: Do keep violet on active or primary actions and copper on ratings, metadata, and brand accents.
Do use Fraunces for story-led headings and Source Sans 3 for operational text.
Do preserve cover and landscape-art proportions, and keep titles legible over artwork with a dark vignette.
Do separate ordinary feed and library entries with dividers; use depth where artwork or an overlay needs it.
Do provide a visible keyboard focus treatment and descriptive labels for icon-only actions.
Do keep sample, empty, error, and spoiler-hidden states visually distinct and readable.
Do keep web, Android emulator and physical-device evidence distinct; native screenshots verify their captured size only.
donts: Don't add decorative scroll animation, stagger every feed entry, or insert a startup animation.
Don't turn routine feed rows into elevated generic cards.
Don't carry the website's fixed desktop rails or custom bottom bar into Android when native navigation is already implemented.
Don't shrink action labels or journal notes to the current smallest metadata size.
Don't infer native reduced-motion behavior or physical performance from static captures; verify those operating-system states separately.
